subject: Post-discovery: pick a 30-minute briefing window and stakeholders
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>
Date: 2026-12-03T16:22:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + 3 short windows for a 30-min briefing

Hi Tom / Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: CloudBridge is focusing on predictable inference latency for user-facing features and tightening unit cost on embeddings-heavy pipelines. You mentioned three priorities — SLA requirements, on-prem/private deployment constraints, and an evaluation timeline for Q1.

Next step: a compact 30-minute product walkthrough (no heavy slides, live demo + Q&A) so your engineering and infra folks can validate latency/cost tradeoffs. Can you pick one of these windows? I’ve kept them within PT-friendly hours to match your team:

- Tue, Dec 8 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed, Dec 9 15:00–15:30 PT
- Fri, Dec 11 09:00–09:30 PT

If none work, propose two alternatives and I’ll loop in our engineer. Suggested attendees: your infra lead + one product owner. I’ll include a short agenda (attached) and a mutual action plan after we lock time.

Attachments: RBW-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page) — high-level demo flow and prep asks.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — making inference predictable and economical
From: Tom Reynolds <tom@cloudbridge.io>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T18:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 3 short windows for a 30-min briefing

Marissa —

Appreciate the tidy recap. Wed, Dec 9 15:00–15:30 PT works best for our team. I’ll invite Alyssa (product) and our infra lead, Kevin Cho (kevin@cloudbridge.io).

One ask ahead of the walk-through: can you include a short surface-level note about private deployment options (VPC/on-prem) and what we should expect for a PoC infra footprint? Not a deep dive — 2–3 bullet points will do.

Tom
CTO, CloudBridge
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom@cloudbridge.io>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@cloudbridge.io>, Kevin Cho <kevin@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T19:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + 3 short windows for a 30-min briefing

Great — Wed, Dec 9 15:00–15:30 PT is locked. I sent a calendar invite (see related link) and attached the single-page agenda plus a draft mutual action plan to help scope the PoC.

@Kevin — looping in Ben (solutions engineer) and Mateo (inference lead) so they can cover the private-deploy bullets Tom asked for. High-level points we’ll touch on in the 5-minute infra segment:

- Typical PoC footprint: 1–2 GPUs (A10/A100 family) for ingestion + 1 smaller instance for orchestration and KV cache; network egress considerations for hybrid flows.
- Data connectivity: VPC peering or private connect; we can run with customer-controlled keys (KMS) for eval.
- Expected perf: we’ll bring sample perf curves for your sequence lengths and show quantized vs full-precision cost deltas.

Prep asks (short):
- If you can share a rough token/embedding volume estimate for Q1, we’ll bring cost scenarios.
- Confirm the infra attendee (Kevin) or name a substitute.

Attachments: RBW-30min-demo-agenda.pdf (stub), mutual-action-plan-v1.docx (stub).

Thanks — see you on Wed.
Marissa
Senior AE | Redwood Inference

Hi Tom / team —

Quick note from the engineering side: we’ll plan a short live demo showing a 512-token request path and one embeddings batch (10k vectors) so you can see latency and cost in real time. If you have an existing dataset or sample requests you want us to run against, drop them in the Drive link in the calendar invite or send to ben.carter@redwood.com.

I’ll also prep two slides that summarize the PoC infra footprint and expected throughput at the start of the call. No heavy setup required.

—Ben
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
